long_biography.plain_text:
Mega's formative years placed Giannis “Johnny” Kalimeris at the centre of Greece's new private-television landscape. As programme director, he oversaw domestic productions and helped develop drama and entertainment closely associated with the channel. He later crossed into public service, managing ERT television and returning as an adviser and board member.

Kalimeris went on to hold senior roles at Alpha, ANT1 and Open, moving between programming strategy and overall channel management. The work ranged from commissioning Greek fiction to steering schedules and broader network operations. In 2025 he joined Silvermedia as a content-development adviser, applying his broadcast experience to independent audiovisual production.
